name: agent-payment-mcp
description: MCP/API pay-per-call billing for AI agents. Buyers fund spend-capped Pay Tokens by card; agents call paid APIs without per-call API keys or crypto wallets. Demo Mode works with zero signup.

LC_PAY_TOKEN.description: Spend-capped Pay Token JWT from lemoncake.xyz/app or a buy link. Optional in Demo Mode.

LC_BUYER_KEY.description: Buyer Key for minting new Pay Tokens off-session. Optional in Demo Mode.
